- Found (Session A build pass, branch `feat/S1.8-seen-on`, 2026-09-19; docs reconciled 2026-09-25 after the session was cut off): (1) a plain `mentions.project_id` FK would cascade-delete mentions with their project, and the S1.5a fold deletes the duplicate row — without a rule, folding a listing that has curated mentions silently turns them into "about OddSense generally"; PostgREST has no per-row bulk UPDATE and an upsert on `mentions` trips NOT NULL before ON CONFLICT, so "one transaction" needs an RPC. (2) The Open Graph read is the one request in the app whose URL somebody else chose: `fetchText` follows redirects on its own, reads the whole body and never looks at the media type, so it cannot re-check hops or bound a page; every `*_API_BASE`-style override on that adapter would be a way to aim it at a private host, and the `main` `.env.test` value assumed one. (3) `listVideos` drops live items and maps three parts for a job that needs one number per id, and step 3's `listVideos([id])` would take "the first item" of whatever the upstream answered; a hidden view count must not overwrite a number the admin typed. (4) `file:` / `javascript:` links must be `validation` before any resolver runs, so the URL rule is a schema rule; an Open Graph page often has no site name, so `creator_name` is nullable in the preview; the guard must not be an oracle (every failure is one message). (5) `auth.uid()` is NULL under the service client; the unique constraint is the only race-free `conflict`; `updateMention` needs `not_found` and a half-patched YouTube id needs the stored row. (6) `DASHBOARD_SYNC_SOURCES` would put a mentions row on `/admin`, where nothing else about mentions lives; J-S's "≥ 1 YouTube mention" counted rows the job never refreshes. (7) `/seen-on` is ISR and may not read `searchParams`, so an island owns the filter; 02 §1.1 lists a `ReachLine` that §2.6's section list never places; the select never offers a project without a mention, so T-E2E-10's `pixel-chameleon` recipe cannot yield the empty state. (8) A card-wide `<a>` around a creator link and a project link is axe `nested-interactive`; a YouTube mention saved without a video id has no player, and V-04 had no word for it; the pass-3 Seen On artboard draws a title line on every card that DESIGN.md §12.1's sentence omits; a mention card is a grid card, so §12.7's 56px applies and ADR-0043 D7's "`mention` 88px" was written before one existed; `PixelLabel` refuses more than five words and the reach line is eight. (9) The admin page's own order (newest added first) must not reshuffle under a reorder; a moderator's read is RLS-filtered, and widening the policy is the wrong fix; "Feature" at the column default 0 would tie every newly featured row at the front of the Home strip; 00's risk note asks for Move up / Move down buttons the 03 row never had. (10) The `MentionPreview` states e2e reaches in a browser are cheap to pin as static markup, but COV-6 as worded forbids any render test; the fixture server had no way to answer a single-id `videos` request with a different file from the sync batch; COV-1 had never been wired.
- Related: refines **ADR-0043 D7** (the `mention` play-block size only — ADR-0043 is not edited; every other size stands) and **ADR-0043 D17**'s "`oembed` has no test-only base override yet (S1.8 decides)" (D7 here); **extends ADR-0038 D1** (the "Saved." wiring list gains `/admin/mentions` — D23) and **ADR-0030 D3** (the J-S `mentions` condition — D13); follows ADR-0002 C7 (admin-only actions), #21 (V-04), #33 (no remote thumbnails), #62 (empty filter), #73 (fixture server), ADR-0037 D3 (the fold — D3 adds one step), ADR-0043 D2 (gather then write — D12), D4 / D6 (island + pure module precedents — D14 / D15). 03 §11 O-24 gains a pointer (D27); O-25 / O-26 stay DECIDED (D16 adds one word to V-04). `DESIGN.md` is not edited: D16's title line follows the pass-3 artboard, D17 follows §12.7, D20 follows 02 §2.6's binding copy over the artboard's tile sublines. Q41 / Q44 (`docs/questions.md`) are built as answered — neutral placeholder marks stay. Supersedes nothing.

## Decision
1. **`mentions` as built (migration `20260919120000_mentions.sql`).** `created_at` + `updated_at` with the shared `set_updated_at` trigger (the data-model header convention; the §2.3b column row is amended); `project_id` FK `on delete set null` and `created_by` FK `on delete set null` — a mention is never deleted with its project or its author (01 INV-24); CHECKs mirror `createMentionInput`: `mentions_url_format` (`^https://`, ≤ 2048), `mentions_external_id_length` (1..64), `mentions_title_length` (1..200), `mentions_creator_name_length` (1..80), `mentions_view_count_check` (≥ 0), `mentions_youtube_external_id_format` (`platform <> 'youtube' or external_id is null or external_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}$'`); unique `mentions_url_key`; indexes `mentions_project_id_idx`, `mentions_created_by_idx`, `mentions_status_published_at_idx (status, published_at desc)`; three enums `mention_platform` / `mention_status` / `mention_source`; RLS `mentions_select_published_or_admin` (`status = 'published' or is_admin()`) and insert / update / delete `is_admin()` — a moderator is a plain D. `status='suggested'` / `source='auto'` are reserved (S2.4); nothing in S1.8 writes them.
2. **RPC `reorder_mentions(p_items jsonb) returns integer` (migration `20260919120100`) is the one transaction of `updateMention({reorder})`.** One `update … from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items)` over every listed row; a listed id that matches no row → P0002 and nothing applied; a payload the schema would never send (not an array, an item without `id` / `sort_order`, an id twice) → 22023; an empty array → 0. `security definer`, `search_path = public`, `volatile`; EXECUTE revoked from every role and granted to `service_role` only (the `fold_project` pattern). The 1..200 cap is schema-level only (`updateMentionInput`, D10) — the RPC itself has no length check; reachable only through the service client after `requireRole('admin')` (supabase-reviewer round 1 #11). T-RLS-129 gains the grants + behaviour leg.
3. **`fold_project` re-parents the duplicate's mentions (migration `20260919120200`, step g2 between (g) and (h)):** `update mentions set project_id = canonical where project_id = duplicate`; `featured` / `sort_order` / `status` ride the row; the returned jsonb keeps its nine ADR-0037 D3 keys. T-ACT-81 gains the leg.
4. **SEED-10's open columns are pinned:** `…0301` title "Metal Pipe Mace is the loudest mod I have ever installed", `creator_url https://www.youtube.com/@seedcreator`, `thumbnail_url https://i.ytimg.com/vi/seedvid0001/hqdefault.jpg`, `published_at 2026-06-14T16:00:00Z`, `sort_order 1`; `…0302` title "this mod makes no sense and I love it", `creator_url https://www.tiktok.com/@seedtok`, `thumbnail_url NULL`, `published_at 2026-05-02T12:00:00Z`, `sort_order 2`; both `source 'manual'`, `created_by` = the seed admin `…0001`; every date a fixed literal older than seven days, the YouTube row the newer one (newest-first on `/seen-on` is deterministic). `SEED_MENTIONS = { youtube, tiktok }` in `tests/helpers/seedIds.ts`.
5. **`fetchPage` joins `fetchJson` / `fetchText` in `lib/adapters/http.ts` — the same request loop (SC-09 / INV-26 amended to name three functions).** GET only; resolves to `FetchedPage {status, location, contentType, text}`; three OPT-IN guards on `FetchTextOptions` — `redirect: 'manual'` (a 301/302/303/307/308 is returned with its raw `Location`, never followed), `contentTypes` (a 2xx whose media type is not listed → `unsupported`, body unread), `maxBytes` (a `Content-Length` over the cap → `unsupported` before the read; otherwise the body is streamed and cut the moment the DECODED byte count passes the cap). Left unset, `fetchJson` / `fetchText` behave exactly as before. No new package.
6. **The `oembed` adapter (`lib/adapters/oembed.ts`) as built — `createOembed({fetch, env, lookup})`, and it has NO base-URL override of any kind.** Env needs only `MODRINTH_USER_AGENT`; `lookup` is the injectable resolver (default `node:dns/promises` `lookup` with `all: true`). `assertPublicHost(url)` returns the NORMALISED `URL` to request and rejects in this order: > 2048 chars / unparseable; scheme not `http:` / `https:`; userinfo; `http:` upgraded to `https:` and any explicit port that survives → rejected (every hop is https on 443); trailing dots stripped, fragment dropped, empty host rejected; an IP literal → `isPublicAddress`, no DNS; a name on the deny-list (`localhost`, `*.localhost`, `*.local`, `*.internal`, `*.home.arpa`, `*.lan`, `*.intranet`, `*.corp`, `*.home`, any single-label host) → rejected; DNS under a 3 s cap (`DNS_TIMEOUT_MS`) → resolver failure `network_error`, no address or ANY non-public address → rejected. `isPublicAddress` = an IPv4 deny-list (this-network, RFC1918, CGNAT, loopback, link-local, protocol assignments, the three TEST-NETs, 6to4 relay, benchmarking, multicast, reserved + broadcast) and an IPv6 ALLOW-list (`2000::/3` minus `2001::/23`, `2001:db8::/32`, `2002::/16`, `3fff::/20`). `fetchOpenGraph(url)` = guard → `fetchPage` with `redirect: 'manual'`, `retries: 0`, `maxBytes` 1 MB (`OG_MAX_BYTES`), `contentTypes` html / xhtml, `Accept: text/html`; ≤ 3 redirects (`OG_MAX_REDIRECTS`), each `Location` resolved against the current hop and sent through the guard again; ONE 10 s budget (`OG_TIMEOUT_MS`) for the whole chain; too many / looping / location-less redirects, an oversized body or a non-HTML answer → `unsupported`. It returns parsed fields only — `{title, image, site_name, canonical, published_at, og_type}`, `image` / `canonical` kept only as clean `https:` URLs under the same policy — and every error names the page by ORIGIN only with an empty `body`. `parseOpenGraph(html, url)` (exported) is hand-rolled and linear (one forward scan, 4,096-char tag cap, comments / raw-text elements skipped, first non-empty value per key, `property` or `name`, UTF-8 only); no title at all → `parse_error`. `detectPlatform` matches a domain and its subdomains on a dot boundary (`evilyoutube.com` → `article`) and never answers `other`. `OEMBED_BASE` (test-only) re-aims ONLY the YouTube oEmbed endpoint of `lib/adapters/youtube.ts`; `.env.test` sets it to `http://127.0.0.1:4010/youtube/oembed` (answered by `youtube/oembed.json` through the `.json` fallback). No env value, `E2E` or `NODE_ENV` ever relaxes the guard. DNS rebinding (check-time vs connect-time lookup) is an accepted residual risk: no pinning without a new dependency (INV-78) or a second HTTP path (INV-26); neutralised in practice by https-only (a rebound internal address cannot complete the TLS handshake for the attacker's name), all-addresses checking, no retry, parsed-fields-only output and the admin-only, rate-limited caller.
7. **`youtube` adapter additions.** `listVideoStats(ids) → VideoStats[]` (`part=statistics` in batches of ≤ 50, strictly sequential, one unit each; ids that are not 11 url-safe chars never sent; duplicates asked once; live / upcoming items KEPT; a hidden count → `view_count: null`; an unanswered id absent) is what `refreshMentions` calls — not `listVideos`. `getVideoMeta(id) → VideoMeta | null` (`part=snippet,statistics` for ONE id, 1 unit; answers only for the item whose `id` IS `id`, never `items[0]`; a malformed id → `null` with no request; a matched item without a title → `parse_error`) is step 3 of 04 §5.4 — not `listVideos([id])`. Neither touches `MappedVideo` / `mapVideo`. New value exports `youtubeVideoStatsItemSchema`, `videoStatsResponseSchema`, `youtubeVideoMetaItemSchema`, `videoMetaResponseSchema`; types `VideoStats`, `VideoMeta`. A YouTube mention's stored / previewed `thumbnail_url` is the first adapter-returned URL on `i.ytimg.com`, else the `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/<id>/hqdefault.jpg` literal (`mentionThumbnail`, the one place it is spelled); the public surfaces never render the stored value (D14).
8. **`fetchMentionPreview` as built.** The URL rule is a SCHEMA rule (`readMentionUrl`, `lib/validation/mention-url.ts`): parseable, ≤ 2048, `http:` / `https:` only (so `file:` / `javascript:` / `data:` are `validation` before any resolver runs), no credentials, `http:` upgraded; the parsed value is the normalised href of what was pasted, not the canonical form. Order: `requireRole('admin')` → `assertRateLimit('mention_preview', …, 30, '1 minute')` → step 1 `assertPublicHost` for EVERY platform (its normalised URL is what every later step uses) → YouTube: step 2 `youtube.oembed` (title, creator, creator link, thumbnail), step 3 `getVideoMeta` only with `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` and a readable id (views + date, and any field step 2 left empty — step 2 wins the title) → step 4 `fetchOpenGraph` for every other platform, and for YouTube only when 2 AND 3 produced no title → step 5 normalise (trim; title ≤ 200; creator ≤ 80; `creator_url` / `thumbnail_url` https and ≤ 512 else `null`; `canonical_url` = `canonicalMentionUrl`; the D7 thumbnail rule). `source` = `data_api` when step 3 returned the video, else `oembed`, else `og`. `creator_name` is `string | null` in `MentionPreviewData` (an Open Graph page often has none; the island opens the manual fields). Every `AdapterError` that ends the chain — SSRF refusal, DNS, timeout, 4xx / 5xx, non-HTML, no title — is the ONE `upstream_error` message "Couldn't read that page. You can fill the fields by hand." (the guard is no oracle); the reason is one server-side `warn` line with the step and the adapter's error code, never the URL; anything that is not an `AdapterError` → `internal`. Nothing stored, nothing revalidated.
9. **`createMention` as built.** Stores the CANONICAL link (`canonicalMentionUrl`: `utm_*` / `si` / `feature` dropped case-insensitively, every YouTube form → `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`, `http:` → `https:`; nothing else is rewritten); uniqueness is the constraint — 23505 → `conflict` on `url`, no pre-read; `project_id` `null` or existing (a 23503 mid-call is the same `validation` on `project_id`); `source 'manual'`; `created_by` = the acting admin, set by the action (`auth.uid()` is NULL under the service client); for `platform 'youtube'` the link's own video id is `external_id` (a caller's value only when the link carries none) and the thumbnail follows D7; revalidates `mentions` + the attached `project:<slug>`, never `projects`. `createMentionInput`: `project_id` required and nullable; optional keys absent-or-valued (never `null`); `creator_url` / `thumbnail_url` = the 04 §1.4 shared URL rule (https, ≤ 512); a `youtube` row's `external_id` must be 11 url-safe chars (refused in words — `NOT_A_YOUTUBE_ID`); `sort_order` within `integer`. Schemas, input types and result shapes live in `lib/actions/mentions.schema.ts` (ADR-0013 pattern).
10. **`updateMention` as built.** `{id, patch}`: every create key except `url` (a `url` key is stripped — a mention's link never changes), all optional, at least one present; the keys optional on create may be `null` = clear; only the keys present are written; unknown `id` → `not_found`; unknown `patch.project_id` → `validation` on `project_id`; a YouTube row must keep an 11-char `external_id` — checked against the STORED half when the patch carries only one of `platform` / `external_id` → `validation` on `external_id`; revalidates `mentions` + the project it left + the project it joined, each once. `{reorder}`: 1..200 pairs, each id once → RPC `reorder_mentions` (D2); an unknown id → `not_found`, nothing applied; revalidates `mentions` once — `sort_order` only orders the Home strip, so no per-project tag. 05 T-ACT-64's "sequential ints" reads: the client sends 1..n and the rows hold exactly what was sent (nothing is renumbered server-side). `suggested` is unreachable from both schemas; a suggested row goes live only by an explicit `patch.status = 'published'`. A value fitting neither form fails as ONE issue at path `''` (the `curateProject` behaviour).
11. **`triggerSync({source: 'mentions'})` runs `refreshMentions`; its "Sync now" lives on `/admin/mentions`.** `lib/data/admin.ts` exports `MENTIONS_SYNC_SOURCES = ['mentions']` (+ type `MentionsSyncSource`) for that page's `SyncStatus` (a SYNC section under the table); `DASHBOARD_SYNC_SOURCES` (`/admin`) and `PROJECT_SYNC_SOURCES` (`/admin/projects`) are unchanged. `full: true` is still youtube-only. T-ACT-42's `mentions` arm now runs the job.
12. **`refreshMentions` as built (04 §3.4 amended).** Gather, then write (ADR-0043 D2): (1) read the eligible rows, paged at 1,000 — `platform = 'youtube'`, `external_id IS NOT NULL`, `status in MENTION_REFRESH_STATUSES` (= `['draft', 'published']`, `lib/jobs/constants.ts`, a rule's code home, not a tunable); (2) `listVideoStats(<distinct ids>)` — ANY batch failing fails the whole gather, nothing from the batches that answered is written; (3) a row changes only when the API answered ITS id with a non-null count that differs — a missing id, a hidden count (`null`) and the same number are all `unchanged` (a stored number, possibly typed by the admin, is never overwritten with NULL); (4) the changed rows' `projects.slug` read in chunks of 50; any of 1–4 failing → `ok=false`, zero writes, no tags, `sync.failed` per J-F; (5) writes one row at a time, each guarded on the `external_id` AS READ (a row `updateMention` re-pointed meanwhile keeps its number — no match → `unchanged`, the ADR-0043 D21 guard), per-row errors counted in `summary.errors[]` (≤ 20, entries ≤ 300 chars) and never rethrown, `ok=false` only when > 50 % of the attempted rows failed. The only column written is `view_count`; `mentions` has no `synced_at`, so a no-change run writes nothing and revalidates nothing (J-I); revalidate `mentions` once + `project:<slug>` per changed mention on a project, only when ≥ 1 row changed. No key → the run still writes its `sync_runs` row (`ok=true`, `error 'not configured'`) and returns `{ok:true, items:0, skipped:'not_configured'}` — no adapter built, no request, no read. Summary `{items: <rows updated>, mentions, asked, returned, updated, unchanged, units, errors[]}`; the runner's `done` / `failed` line carries `meta.units` on the failure path too; the key never appears (`key=[redacted]` — SC-15). The J-F edge + delivery leg for this job is titled "T-ACT-74 refreshMentions" and joins 05 §8 row S1.8 (00 S1.8.AC7 had T-ACT-33 / 54 only).
13. **`notifyFanOut` F0's `mentions` condition is the job's own select:** `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` set AND ≥ 1 mention with `platform 'youtube'`, `external_id` not null, `status in MENTION_REFRESH_STATUSES` — a hidden-only or id-less YouTube table is never stale (04 J-S ** amended; extends ADR-0030 D3). T-ACT-32 gains the `mentions` leg.
14. **The pure, client-safe `lib/mentions.ts` declares the prop shapes; `lib/data/mentions.ts` is ONE cached reader.** `lib/mentions.ts` (no directive, no env, no zod): `MENTION_PLATFORMS`, `MentionPlatform`, `MentionCardData` (nullable `creatorUrl` / `thumbnailUrl` / `publishedAt` / `viewCount`), `PublishedMention` (+ `featured`, `sortOrder`, `createdAt`), `ReachTotals`, `MentionFilters`, `GENERAL_PROJECT_VALUE = 'odsens'`, `platformLabel`, `linkOutChipLabel`, `isPlayableInline`, `mentionThumbnail`, `reachTotals`, `newestFirst` (`publishedAt` desc, undated last, `createdAt` desc, `id`), `featuredMentions` (featured by `sortOrder`, ties newest, at most 4), `projectMentions` (featured first, then newest), `platformCounts`, `projectOptions`, `parseMentionFilters`, `applyMentionFilters` — re-exported with `export type` by the data layer (the ADR-0043 D6 split). `lib/data/mentions.ts` (server-only, anon client): `listPublishedMentions` (`unstable_cache` key `['data-mentions-list']`, tags `mentions` + `projects`, 600 s; explicit `status = 'published'` beside RLS) and the wrappers `getHomeMentions`, `getProjectMentions(slug)`, `getSeenOnMentions` — one cache entry serves Home, the project page and `/seen-on`. A published mention whose `project_id` names a project that is NOT publicly visible (`projects_public` has no row) is DROPPED from the public list — never shown as "about OddSense generally", never linked to a 404. `thumbnailUrl` leaves the data layer as `mentionThumbnail(row)` — the `i.ytimg.com` literal for a playable YouTube row, `null` for everything else; a stored thumbnail from any other host never reaches a component (ADR-0002 #33; 01 INV-54). `reachTotals.videos` counts every published mention, every platform (SEED-10 reads `2 VIDEOS`); `creators` compares names trimmed and case-insensitively.
15. **New client island `components/seen-on/SeenOnGrid.tsx` owns the `/seen-on` filter state** (03 §1.4 + §2.8 rows added in Session A): `useSearchParams` inside the page's `<Suspense>`, whose FALLBACK is the second export `SeenOnGridView` with `query=""` — the bar and every card are in the ISR HTML and the resolved island renders identical markup for an unfiltered visit. `FilterBar` gains the additive second export `FilterBarView` (the bar for a query string it is GIVEN, no URL read — the `VideoStage` / `VideoStageView` precedent). A `platform` / `project` value the bar does not offer falls away silently; counts are over the full list, never faceted by the select; the project select lists projects with ≥ 1 mention A→Z + "About OddSense" last (only when a general mention exists); `<ul>` 3 / 2 / 1-up, gap 20, order as given, every card `withProjectFooter`; sr-only `aria-live="polite"` "Showing n of N".
16. **`MentionCard` as built.** Two cards, one `<article>` shell (2px `--line-soft`, no `overflow: hidden`): a YouTube mention with a well-formed id plays inline (`VideoFacade variant="mention"`, `onPlay` → `data-state="playing"`, the `--indigo-lift` outline, the "on YouTube ↗" ghost link in the creator row; a `MutationObserver` on the facade's `data-state` returns the card to `idle` when another facade takes the slot — never two outlined cards; the outline is the playing signal ONLY, no hover outline); everything else links out — every other platform AND a YouTube mention whose `externalId` is null or malformed, worded **`WATCH ON YOUTUBE`** (03 V-04 gains the word). The link-out card has NO card-wide anchor (a creator link and a project link inside it would be axe `nested-interactive`): the thumb slot is the one `<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">` — a 16:9 `--slab-sunk` well with a centred 26px `PlatformMark`, the `↗` chip top-right, the V-04 `PixelLabel` chip bottom-left, sr text ": <title> (opens in new tab)" — and the creator name (when `creatorUrl` is https) and the footer project title are links of their own. Body: the creator line (26px `PlatformMark` `role="img"`, name 14px 700, view count `PixelLabel` emerald 11px informational — `1 VIEW` singular, omitted when null, never "0 VIEWS" —, date `relativeTime` in `--mute-dim` with `suppressHydrationWarning`), then the mention's **title as one quiet `<h3>`** (14px 400 `--mute`, 2-line clamp — the pass-3 Seen On artboard draws a title on every card; DESIGN.md §12.1 lists the creator line only and is not edited). While playing, the date steps aside when a count is shown (measured at 390: both beside the ghost link wrapped the row); the creator row always holds the 44px the link needs, so nothing moves when it appears. `withProjectFooter` = `--slab-foot` strip, 2px top `--line`, `TypeBadge` + the project title link (13px 700 `--indigo-lift`, 44px target) or `PlatformMark platform="odsens"`. No analytics event on the link-out.
17. **`VideoFacade variant="mention"` has a 56px play block** (`short` + `card` + `mention`; `hero` 88; `upnext` 44) — DESIGN.md §12.7 "56px (Shorts and grid cards)": a mention card is a grid card. Refines ADR-0043 D7; 03 §2.6 `VideoFacade` amended; `DESIGN.md` not edited. The mention facade passes `durationSeconds={null}` (no duration is stored — no chip).
18. **`ReachLine`, `SeenOnRow` and the number formatters as built.** `formatReachLine` (`lib/format/reach.ts`) returns `{text, spoken, segments}` — `segments` = one entry per part (`1.2M VIEWS`, `6 VIDEOS`, `4 CREATORS`), `text` = the segments joined by ` · `, `spoken` = the sr form ("1.2 million views · 6 videos · 4 creators"); singular for exactly 1 (`1 VIEW`, `1 VIDEO`, `1 CREATOR`); `views` 0 / null omits the views segment (ADR-0002 #77); nothing to say → `''` / `[]`. `ReachLine` renders one `PixelLabel tone="emerald" size={11} informational` PER SEGMENT with plain-text separators in the same face (the whole line is eight words; `PixelLabel` guards at five), the visible run `aria-hidden`, the spoken form for screen readers (the component takes `views: number`; the formatter also accepts `null`). `formatCount` gains the `B` tier (`1.5B`; everything past `999.9B` stays in billions) and `lib/format/number.ts` exports `spokenCount` (`1200000` → `1.2 million`, the same rounding). `SeenOnRow`'s count reads `1 MENTION` for one, `N MENTIONS` otherwise, spoken inside the `h2`.

Nothing featured → nothing at all.

Zero published mentions → the title only. There is no `ReachLine` on this page (the tiles carry the totals; 02 §1.1's Components cell is corrected). `loading.tsx` = 3 tile shells + 6 card shells in the real grid.

(ADR-0002 #62). T-E2E-10 is three tests: page, filters (URL state survives a reload, unknown values fall away, the empty leg), play (one nocookie iframe, outline, ghost link, axe in every state).
23. **`/admin/mentions` as built.** Two URL-driven, server-rendered views — `?tab=suggested` for the stub, everything else the mentions view — as two links with `aria-current="page"` (03 C-13: no ARIA tablist). Mentions view, in order: ADD A MENTION (the `MentionPreview` island — D25) → FEATURED ORDER (`ReorderableList` "Featured mentions" over the published + featured rows by `sort_order`, exactly what the Home strip reads; rendered only when something is featured; help line "The first four fill the Home strip, top to bottom. Drag a handle or use the arrows."; one completed reorder = ONE `updateMention({reorder})` with `sort_order` 1..n) → ALL MENTIONS (`Table`, newest ADDED first — `listAdminMentions` orders by `created_at` desc, `id` asc, so a reorder never reshuffles it; columns Mention (title as a new-tab link over "Platform · creator", 24px `PlatformMark`) · Project (title, or "About OddSense") · Views (`formatCount`, `—` when null) · Status (`StatusPill` `featured` / `live` / `hidden` / `draft` / `suggested` via `adminMentionStatus`: a published row is FEATURED when it feeds the strip, else LIVE) · Actions: LIVE → Feature + Hide, FEATURED → Unfeature + Hide, HIDDEN → Show, DRAFT → Publish, SUGGESTED → none; **"Feature" also sends `sort_order` = one past the last featured row**, so a newly featured mention joins the END of the strip; `N TOTAL` `PixelLabel`; empty copy "Nothing pasted yet." verbatim) → SYNC (`SyncStatus` over `MENTIONS_SYNC_SOURCES` — D11). Every row action is a server `<form action>` bound to one `updateMention` call, then PRG: `ok` → `?saved=saved` → `SavedToast` "Saved." (extends ADR-0038 D1's wiring list); a refused or failed call lands on the bare URL, no toast. Suggested view = one `EmptyState` "NOTHING SUGGESTED" / "Auto-found mentions will wait here for a yes or no. Not yet." under a COMING LATER label — no Approve / Dismiss, no count, nothing that mutates (00 S1.8.AC10). Intro "Paste a link, check the preview, publish. Nothing shows up on its own."; the `h1` is visually hidden, ADMIN is the eyebrow; anon / no-handle / role `user` → the page returns `null` under the layout gate (RP-04). Moderators: every mutation control rendered natively `disabled` under `title="Admin only"` with NO `<form>` around it — nothing can leave the page; the actions refuse them regardless. `loading.tsx` = eyebrow + intro, two tabs, the add slab, a six-row table shell.

The list is capped at `ADMIN_MENTIONS_LIMIT` = 200 (= the reorder maximum). Project titles come from ONE `projects_public` read; an id the view does not show falls back to `projects.title` under the same session's RLS, else `—`. `listMentionProjectOptions` = every publicly visible project, title A→Z, locale-free; the island puts "About OddSense generally" first.
25. **`MentionPreview` as built — the island owns the Fetch and PUBLISH calls (03 C-07).** Props `{ preview: MentionPreviewData | null; error?; projects; manual?; readOnly?; className? }` — the 03 props are the island's INITIAL state (the page passes `preview={null}`; `/dev/components` fixtures show each state statically). It renders the link `Field` + "Fetch" (`fetchMentionPreview`), the four states (`empty` — dashed slot "Paste a link above.", PUBLISH rendered DISABLED; `preview` — the card: thumb · title · mark + "Platform · creator" · views · date, ghost "Edit fields"; `error` — the action's message verbatim in a `role="alert"` line above the manual fields; `manual` — Title · Creator · Platform (`Select`, all six incl. `other`) · Creator link · Date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, UTC) · Views, seeded from the preview), and "Assign to" (`Select`, "About OddSense generally" first and default = `project_id: null`) + PUBLISH (`createMention`) in ONE row under every state. A fetched preview without a title or a creator name opens `manual`. PUBLISH always sends `status: 'published'`, `featured: false`; optional keys are omitted, never `null`; `url` = the preview's `canonical_url` when a page was read, else the pasted link; `external_id` / `thumbnail_url` ride along only while the draft still names the platform the preview found; a fetched `creator_url` / `thumbnail_url` the shared URL rule would refuse is dropped when the draft is seeded. Result handling: fetch `validation` → the link field, anything else → `error`; publish ok → `empty`, focus on the link field, `Toast` "Saved." + `router.refresh()`; `conflict` → the link field; `validation` issues → their own field (the manual fields open when an issue lands on one not on screen); anything else → one `role="alert"` line by the button; errors are never toasts (03 C-30). Editing the link after a fetch drops the fetched preview. Thumbnail = `mentionThumbnail()` through `next/image` and nothing else (the fetched `thumbnail_url` is never an image source). `readOnly` (moderators): every control natively `disabled` under `title="Admin only"`, no `<form>`, no handler. The pure half lives in `components/seen-on/MentionPreview.draft.ts` (`MentionDraft`, `EMPTY_DRAFT`, `guessPlatform` — the client-safe twin of the 04 §4.4 hostname map, `draftForUrl`, `draftFromPreview`, `previewIsComplete`, `buildCreateMentionInput`, `fetchErrors`, `publishErrors`, `hasFieldError`, `PASTE_A_LINK`, `DATE_MESSAGE`, `VIEWS_MESSAGE`). ## Alternatives considered
| Alternative | Why not |
|---|---|
| `project_id` FK `on delete cascade` (D1) | Deletes a mention with its project — INV-24 says never; the fold would lose curated coverage. |
| Sequential `update`s or an `upsert` batch for the reorder (D2) | Not one transaction; `upsert([{id, sort_order}])` raises 23502 on `mentions` (NOT NULL is checked before ON CONFLICT). |
| Count `mentions_moved` in the fold's jsonb (D3) | `linkProjectListing` and T-ACT-81 pin the nine-key shape; the count is a service-side read away. |
| Give `oembed` an `OEMBED_BASE`-style override like the other adapters (D6) | Any base override is a way to point the one attacker-chosen request at a private host; unit tests inject `fetch` + `lookup` instead. |
| Pin the resolved address on the transport (D6) | Needs an `undici` `connect` option or a second HTTP path — INV-78 / INV-26; the residual risk is neutralised by https-only + all-addresses checking. |
| Follow redirects with `fetchText` and re-check the final URL (D6) | The transport would already have connected to every hop; only `redirect: 'manual'` lets each hop be guarded before its request. |
| A `<meta>` regex over the document (D6) | Lazy regex over a 1 MB hostile page is quadratic; the linear scanner is bounded per tag. |
| Reuse `listVideos` in the job and the preview (D7) | It drops live items (a view count is a view count), maps three parts and would take "the first item" for a single-id lookup. |
| Overwrite `view_count` with NULL when the creator hides the count (D12) | A number the admin typed in `createMention` would vanish on the next hour; a hidden count is "unknown", not zero. |
| Keep the `mentions` row on `/admin` via `DASHBOARD_SYNC_SOURCES` (D11) | Nothing else about mentions lives on the dashboard; the button belongs beside the table it refreshes. |
| Widen the select policy so moderators see every row (D24) | A read-only degradation costs nothing; a policy change is ADR-R7 territory for no user need. |
| One `<a>` around the whole link-out card (D16) | A creator link and a project link inside it are axe `nested-interactive`; three plain links keep every target 44px. |
| Keep 88px on the mention facade (D17) | A mention card is a grid card; DESIGN.md §12.7 "wins" and ADR-0043 D7 read it that way for `card`. |
| One `PixelLabel` for the whole reach line (D18) | `PixelLabel` throws on more than five words under `pnpm dev`; the line is eight. |
| Read the tile totals from `stats_daily` (D20) | The `reach` snapshot is S1.9's; the tiles are live sums over the one cached list. |
| Renumber `sort_order` server-side after a reorder (D10) | The client already sends 1..n; a second renumbering pass would hide a bad payload instead of refusing it. |
| Widen T-E2E-42's phone rule to every admin route (D27) | Admin is desktop-first; only 00 S1.8.AC12 names 390 for an admin page. |
| A jsdom / RTL `components` project for the island (D27) | 03 O-24 (b) rejected for v1 — new dependencies; `renderToStaticMarkup` pins the same attributes with nothing added. |
| Serve `seedvid0009` from `videos-list.json` (D28) | A sync over the fixtures would insert it into `videos`; the single-id rule keeps the preview fixture outside the 21-upload set. |

## Consequences
- Positive: a mention survives its project's deletion or fold; the reorder is atomic; the one attacker-chosen request is guarded on every hop, bounded in size and type, and has no override to abuse; the hourly refresh asks one unit per 50 ids and never destroys a typed number; a failed gather writes nothing; the three public surfaces share one cache entry and never show a mention of an invisible project; `/seen-on` stays ISR with a shareable filter URL; a moderator sees the admin page read-only without a policy change; the admin table never reshuffles under a reorder; every reorder is reachable without a drag.
- Negative: DNS rebinding remains a residual risk (D6); a `/seen-on` visit with `?platform=` swaps in the filtered grid after hydration (the ISR HTML is unfiltered — the `/projects` behaviour); the link-out card's thumb slot is a placeholder, never a picture (ADR-0002 #33 — by design); T-E2E-39 needs real DNS for `www.youtube.com`; a `youtube` mention saved without a video id never plays inline and is never refreshed; `listAdminMentions` has no paging (200 is the ceiling; the reorder maximum); the `mentions` stale check now ignores id-less and hidden YouTube mentions (D13 — a table with nothing to refresh is never stale).
- Follow-ups: official platform marks (Q44) — neutral placeholders until Oliver's asset PR (`add-content`); TikTok / Twitch / Reddit oEmbed endpoints (04 §5.4 "not used in v1") → `docs/questions.md`; a legacy-charset Open Graph page yields a garbled title the admin retypes (D6 — v1 limitation, `docs/questions.md`); Session B flips this ADR to Accepted at merge (`keep-docs`); the S1.9 `reach` snapshot reads `reachTotals` over the same list (`build-phase`); verify `www.youtube.com` resolves in CI on the first run (T-E2E-39 — `test-engineer`).

### Notes — built details judged within the spec's latitude (no deviation; listed so `spec-drift-reviewer` can check them)
- `Footer` renders the second dry line "Creators featuring the mods aren't affiliated with odsens." as a second `<p>` in the same `.footer-line` recipe — 03 §2.1 as written (S1.8.AC9; T-E2E-1).
- `/api/cron/refresh-mentions` is the SC-12 wrapper verbatim (GET only, 405 with `Allow: GET`, `cronAuth`, 500 `job_failed`, `maxDuration` 300); it reads no query parameter (`?full=1` is `/api/cron/sync-youtube`'s alone — 04 §2.4). `vercel.json` carries `37 * * * *`. T-E2E-46 lists the route.
- `/projects/[slug]` reads `getProjectMentions(slug)` beside settings and comments and adds the `mentions` tag to its ISR entry (02 §1.1 row as written); `SeenOnRow` sits between VERSIONS & FILES and COMMENTS.
- Home reads `getHomeMentions()`; the strip sits between Featured and the videos row (02 §2.1 order).
- `lib/validation/mention-url.ts` (`readMentionUrl`, `canonicalMentionUrl`, `MENTION_URL_MAX`, types `MentionUrlProblem`, `MentionUrlResult`) is server-side, not client-safe — it imports `videoIdFromUrl` from the `server-only` youtube adapter so the YouTube URL grammar has one source (the `projects.schema.ts` → `parseRef` precedent); registry add-first rule.
- `lib/actions/mentions.schema.ts` exports `MENTION_REORDER_MAX`, `MENTION_PLATFORM`, `mentionUrlSchema`, `NOT_A_YOUTUBE_ID`, the three `<actionName>Input` schemas, the hand-written input types (`FetchMentionPreviewInput`, `CreateMentionInput`, `MentionPatch`, `UpdateMentionPatchInput`, `UpdateMentionReorderInput`, `UpdateMentionInput`), the `*Values` output types and the result shapes (`MentionRow`, `MentionPreviewData`, `CreateMentionData`, `UpdateMentionData`) — ADR-0013 pattern.
- `lib/data/admin.ts` also exports `adminMentionStatus`, `AdminMentionListItem`, `ADMIN_MENTIONS_LIMIT`; `lib/jobs/constants.ts` exports `MENTION_REFRESH_STATUSES`.
- `lib/supabase/types.ts` carries the regenerated `mentions` table, the three enums and the `reorder_mentions` function — committed raw (01 INV-16).
- The `mentions_youtube_external_id_format` CHECK keeps every stored id sendable; `listVideoStats` filters again (an id typed by hand on a non-YouTube row is never sent).
- The cron route's, `triggerSync`'s and the job's db tests snapshot / restore the content tables (`mentions` + `sync_runs` included) because a run whose upstream answered `seedvid0001` would rewrite SEED-10 — no payload does (05 H-1).
- `MentionPreview`'s "Fetch" and PUBLISH on `/dev/components` call the real actions and answer signed-out with their inline error (the `SyncStatus` precedent — interaction-only states).
- The mention card's date reads `relativeTime` (absolute past seven days); fixtures and SEED-10 are dated older than a week so no screenshot depends on the clock.
- `SeenOnRow` / `InTheWildStrip` / `ReachLine` are Server Components; `MentionCard`, `MentionPreview`, `SeenOnGrid` are the client files (03 §1.4 as written + the added row).
- Gate notes for Session B: `security-reviewer` — the SSRF surface is D6 + D8 (`grep -rn "fetch(" lib` → only `lib/adapters/http.ts`; no override name reaches `lib/adapters/oembed.ts`); `backend-reviewer` — batching and quota are D7 + D12 (`VIDEOS_BATCH` = 50, `summary.units`, the failed-batch rule).
